cases.name: Piper Jean Streyle
cases.narrative:
He had crafted a platform for the back of his Ford Bronco with tie-down rings in two corners. He handcuffed Piper to the rings, and raped and strangled her to death on the board.

In his trailer, authorities found two halves of her shirt, a clump of duct tape with more of Streyle's hair attached to it, as well as rope, chains, eyebolts, a vibrator, and a half-burned candle. It is assumed Anderson used these items to torture Piper.

Her body was never found.
